meta.parties: Costa Et Al. v. Silva Et Al

rules.statement: Under clause 4, only the movable properties enumerated were bequeathed to the survivor; and under clause 5, all other property (both movable and immovable) was bequeathed to the named persons.
rules.supporting_quote: "I do not think that much help is to be derived from any of the cases that were cited in the District Court, or in the arguments on the appeal. In Dean v. Crib son 1 the will in dispute consisted of a single clause, in which the only request was a gift by the testatrix of her ' personal property consisting of money and clothes.'"
